report.scope: Ranked players in standard completed tour-level knockout singles on hard, clay or grass. Rank is the source ranking attached to the match. Event-opening ratings use completed older events only after the later of their last source date and 21 days after their first source date. Outcomes in 2026 update ratings only when their release date precedes the next event. Workload is earlier same-event minutes for both players with contiguous observed prior rounds. When unknown, omit its adjustment. Frozen coefficients selected on 2025 log loss, then fit on pre-2026 data.
